concerns.text: The plan states a *Repeated‑Measures (Within‑Subjects) design* where each participant views all three stimulus conditions (enhanced, reduced, baseline) in a randomized order, but the stimulus generation pipeline creates distinct images for each condition (Phase 0 loads baseline images, Phase 1 creates enhanced/reduced versions). If participants see different base images in each condition rather than the same image presented in all three versions, the condition factor is confounded with image identity, violating the independence assumption required for a valid within‑subjects ANOVA.

The analysis proposes a repeated‑measures ANOVA on *false‑memory rates* (proportions of “Yes” responses to lure items). Proportion data are bounded [0,1] and often non‑normally distributed, especially with small numbers of lure trials per condition. Using `statsmodels.stats.anova.AnovaRM` assumes normally distributed residuals; even with Shapiro‑Wilk checks, the transformation may be insufficient. A generalized linear mixed‑effects model with a binomial (logit) link would be more appropriate and would also allow random effects for items as well as participants.
